property_summary: For any call that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly greater timestamp than the previous call, the reference contract empties its balance (address(c).balance == 0) if and only if the current block.number is a multiple of 15; the mutant inverts that condition and therefore will misalign which block numbers result in balance == 0 for some fuzzed block numbers.
change_summary: Invert the if condition so transfer occurs on non-multiples of 15 instead of multiples, changing when balance is paid out.
